answer: Split tallies block bulk fakes. Each identity stakes 70 credits, holding half a plume-sealed tally; registry holds the rest. Each epoch the holder shows its half for a signed echo. A prism refracts each echo; wrong spectra burn the bond. Each tally costs 42+7(k-1): a thousand fakes owe 3,538,500, lock 70,000; pool holds 40,000. Rented-tally rings fail: copied halves break the plume seal, no echo. Honest agents cut one tally, get the bond back.
